newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, supported by technicals.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, supported by technicals.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were untraded but prices remained firm, bolstered by healthy technicals, brokers said on Tuesday
June were offered at $19.82 per barrel against no bids and July was asked at $19.60. June prices on London's IPE closed at $19.72 and July at $19.47 on Monday.
Brokers current support were technically driven. They said June Brent could hit the $20.00 mark.
Some brokers attribute the support to strong sentiment propped up by bullish expectation of U.S oil data due to be released later Tuesday.
Levels on Monday IPE's session gained 79 cents, supported mainly by technicals and news of renewed Middle East tension provided a further boost.
A top U.S military commander had on Monday pledged to defend the strategic Strait of Hormuz against any Iranian threat.
Prices on ACCESS, the after-hours system were also firm, brokers said. June was last quoted at $21.38 per barrel, unchanged from its last official close.
